_doc: The subset tests/gateway_pipeline.py runs on every push (M9 / `CI-002`). One task per behaviour that reaches a different part of the gateway, kept small enough that the whole cycle fits in a minute on both channels. tests/test_tasks.json is the full fifty, for the nightly soak.

tasks.prompt: Reply with the single word READY.
